Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4409, claude-fable-5-2, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a `feat` PR. It merges at the next cut.

This is the first review of this head. I read the whole diff. The PR adds a recorded program (`sinker.nc`), thus I did a safety-tier review: three mutations and a line-by-line read of the new golden. The PR changes no production code, no post and no machine file.

## What looks good

- The case obeys `examples/catalog/README.md`: `model/` with its generator, `build.camscript`, `case.toml`, `sinker.camproj`, `sinker.nc` and `README.md`.
- The README and the script say that the conditions and the code words are invented. No vendor code is in the case (Clean-Room Protocol).
- The numbers agree with the laws in the source:
  - Rough burn: the electrode is 0.25 mm undersize per side and the tip stops at floor + undersize, `Z17.25`. With the 0.10 mm gap, 0.15 mm stays on the floor and on each wall.
  - Side burn: the tip stops at floor + finish gap, `Z17.03`. The lateral amount 0.22 mm equals the allowance of `sinker_side::allowance` (0.25 undersize - 0.03 gap). The +X wall gets to X15.000.
- The README statement about the refusal is true. `crates/motion/src/sinker_side.rs:128` refuses an amount larger than the undersize minus the gap. The post refuses a Side Burn without the `side` code (`assets/posts/sinker-iso.cps:154`).
- The pin `sinker_case_posts_the_burn_and_the_side_burn` checks the section order, the condition of each section, each servo depth, the two lateral blocks, and that the straight burn has no lateral block.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2872-sinker-catalog.md` has the choice, the reason and the dropped options.
- The body has `Changelog:`, "Goldens moved" and `Fixes #2872`. The commit subject is conventional.

## Golden read, line by line (`examples/catalog/edm/sinker/sinker.nc`, 25 lines)

- Lines 1-3: header note, `G21`, `G90`.
- Lines 4-13, `Rough burn`: `T1 M06`, `M100 H15.` (the pickup 15 mm), `G54`, `ER1`, `G0 X5. Y0. Z50.`, `M101 Z17.25 F50.`, `G0 Z50.`. The feed goes down Z only. The section has no `M102` block.
- Lines 14-24, `Side burn +X`: the same pickup, reference and `G54`, then `EF1`, `G0 X5. Y0. Z50.`, `M101 Z17.03 F50.`, `M102 X5.22 Y0. Z17.03 F50.`, `M102 X5. Y0. Z17.03 F50.`, `G0 Z50.`. The lateral pair is at constant Y and Z. The electrode is back on the cavity centre before the retract.
- Line 25: `M02`.
- Each retract is a rapid to Z50, 25 mm above the work top (Z25). No line moves the electrode laterally below the work top other than the two `M102` blocks.
- No existing `.nc`, `.cl` or catalog file changed.

## Results merged with main (local, trial merge of `23e11a965` with upstream/main `878f8c2f2`, clean)

The trial merge has no conflict. All commands ran locally on m3. No GitHub runner was used.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (10 steps) | 9 steps passed in the first run. `app suites: example_catalog` failed one time: see the note below |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog` (run again, two times) | 47 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored, both times |
| `catalog_edm_sinker::regenerates` | pass |
| `catalog_edm_sinker::rebuilds` | pass |
| `sinker_case_posts_the_burn_and_the_side_burn` | pass |
| `catalog_groove_part_off`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `first_4axis_part`, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `tilt_basis_compat` | pass |
| `cargo xtask catalog --check` | all cases checked, `edm/sinker` included |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed (release build, `motion light: lib`, three `adaptive_troch_*` twins, `app light: pocket_pass_start`) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 2 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored (the screenshot renderer) |

Note on the first quick run: `catalog_3d_rough_finish::rebuilds` did not finish in its 60 s budget.

```
3d/rough-finish rebuilds: did not finish within 60s; move this case to app heavy: example_catalog or reduce its model
```

This is a different case, and this PR does not change it. The host load average was 42 at that time, because other jobs ran on it. The same test alone took 19.6 s. The full suite, run again two times on the same tree, was green (the case took 20.1 s and 19.5 s). I read this failure as host load and not as a defect of this PR. The two new case tests take 0.1 s and 2.1 s.

## Mutations (each one red, then restored; the tree equals the PR head again)

1. `sinker.nc`: `M101 Z17.25` changed to `Z17.15` (a rough burn 0.10 mm too deep). All three pins went red: `rough depth: M101 Z17.15 F50.`, `regenerated NC differs`, `build.camscript NC differs from committed .nc`.
2. `build.camscript`: `side.amount` changed from 0.22 to 0.30. `catalog_edm_sinker::rebuilds` went red with the refusal at `add_operation`: `sinker side burn: a lateral move of 0.300 toward +X burns into the part - it exceeds the electrode undersize 0.250 per side`. The command refuses the value at creation, as the README says.
3. `sinker.nc`: `M102 X5.22` changed to `X5.2`. All three pins went red: `lateral X: M102 X5.2 Y0. Z17.03 F50.` and the two byte compares.

After the restore, the full suite was green (47 passed).

## Extra suites run

- Test data: the diff adds files under `examples/catalog/edm/sinker/` only. I searched `crates/*/tests` for `examples/catalog`.
  - The `example_catalog*` binaries and `catalog_groove_part_off` ran, see the table.
  - `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs` is not in the quick plan. Its test `catalog_cases_open_and_frame_cleanly` opens each catalog project, the new `sinker.camproj` included, and asserts a camera, scene parts and a toolpath overlay. I ran it by name: it passed.
  - `crates/app/tests/plunge_depth_tab.rs` reads only `2d/contour-tabs`. This PR does not change that case, thus I did not run it.
- Importers: the diff does not touch the import code. No kernel STEP suite was owed. The fixture is an OBJ file, thus `step_agreement.rs` needs no row.

## Heavy lanes

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches one step, `app heavy: example_catalog`. That step runs the ignored cases of other families. The new case is not ignored and ran above. I did not run the heavy step. It is not a merge condition (#3556).

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs` goes from 411 to 412 lines with the new `include!` line. The file was above 400 lines before this PR. A later split of the `include!` list can bring it below the limit (suggested `P7`).
2. `examples/catalog/edm/sinker/README.md`: the "What to look at" list can say that each section repeats the pickup `T1 M06` and the reference `M100 H15.` for the same electrode. The post writes them for each section. A reader can ask why.
3. I did not run `model/gen_sinker_obj.py`. I read it: it has a watertight check and it writes only its output file. I did not compare its output with `sinker.obj`.

## Notes

- No UI file changed, thus no screenshots are owed.
- No process file changed.
- The program uses invented code words and was not run on an EDM control. The body says so.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
